# TaskNexus Pro - Comprehensive Project Documentation
## Intelligent Task and Productivity Management System
## Java, JSP, Servlet, Maven, Selenium, Jenkins and Docker Project
## Complete DevOps CI/CD Documentation
## Project Overview
TaskNexus Pro is a Java web application for intelligent task and productivity management.
The application uses Java 17, JSP, Servlets, Maven, Selenium WebDriver, Docker and Jenkins.
The application is packaged as a WAR file and deployed on Apache Tomcat.
Git and GitHub are used for source-code version control.
This document contains detailed project, testing, deployment and DevOps documentation.
